SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME=?

SELECT m.*,t.name AS team_name,t.status AS team_status,COALESCE(s.name,'Průběžně') AS season_name,s.starts_on,s.ends_on,s.status AS season_status FROM club_roster_members m JOIN club_teams t ON t.id=m.team_id LEFT JOIN club_seasons s ON s.id=t.season_id WHERE m.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY COALESCE(s.starts_on,'9999-12-31') DESC,t.name,m.id

SELECT c.*,t.name AS team_name,s.name AS season_name FROM kis_legacy_roster_claims c JOIN club_teams t ON t.id=c.team_id JOIN club_seasons s ON s.id=t.season_id WHERE c.sportovec_id=? AND c.member_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC,t.name

SELECT c.*,COALESCE(t.name,legacy.legacy_label) AS team_name,s.name AS season_name FROM kis_current_roster_claims c JOIN kis_current_roster_runs run ON run.id=c.run_id JOIN club_seasons s ON s.id=run.season_id LEFT JOIN club_teams t ON t.id=COALESCE(c.target_team_id,c.suggested_team_id) LEFT JOIN kis_legacy_roster_claims legacy ON legacy.id=c.legacy_claim_id WHERE c.sportovec_id=? AND c.member_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC,c.id

SELECT e.id,e.created_at,e.action,e.note,e.before_json,e.after_json,t.name AS team_name FROM club_roster_events e JOIN club_roster_members m ON m.id=e.roster_member_id JOIN club_teams t ON t.id=e.team_id WHERE m.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC

SELECT t.id,t.name,COALESCE(s.name,'Průběžně') AS season_name,s.starts_on FROM club_teams t LEFT JOIN club_seasons s ON s.id=t.season_id WHERE t.status='active' AND t.team_kind='roster' ORDER BY COALESCE(s.starts_on,'9999-12-31') DESC,t.name

SELECT c.id,c.public_code,c.title_snapshot,c.amount_minor,c.currency,c.status,c.period_from,c.period_to,c.due_on,c.source_system,p.id AS payment_id,p.status AS payment_status,p.method,p.variable_symbol,p.paid_at FROM club_member_charges c LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payable_type='member_charge' AND p.payable_id=c.id WHERE c.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC

SELECT o.id,o.public_code,o.total_minor,o.currency,o.status,o.payment_status,o.placed_at,o.finance_sportovec_id AS owner_id,p.id AS payment_id,p.status AS ledger_status,p.method,p.variable_symbol,p.paid_at,(SELECT SUM(i.line_amount_minor) FROM shop_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id AND i.beneficiary_sportovec_id=?) AS athlete_items_minor FROM shop_orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payable_type='shop_order' AND p.payable_id=o.id WHERE o.finance_sportovec_id=? OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id AND i.beneficiary_sportovec_id=?) ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC,o.id DESC
